name: Asurion
why: Largest 'other' record by reach (~300M covered customers); national device/tech protection brand with its own My Account billing.

name: Sunrun (incl. former Vivint Solar)
why: Largest US residential solar lease/PPA biller (~705k customers); own Sunrun account portal and AutoPay.

name: Tesla Energy (solar lease/PPA billing)
why: ~323k solar lease/PPA customers; billing in the Tesla account/app.

name: Sunnova (serviced by SunStrong Management)
why: ~245k solar customers now serviced by SunStrong Management; Sunnova lease/PPA accounts pay in the SunStrong Consumer Central portal (esp.myaccountinfo.com/Sunstrong). Picked once for SunStrong; legacy SunPower accounts use a different SunStrong portal (sunstrong.youronlineaccount.com) and are not modelled here.

name: Progressive Leasing
why: National lease-to-own provider at major retailers; own customer portal with payments and autopay.

name: Rent-A-Center
why: Largest US rent-to-own chain; online account with payments and AutoPay.

name: Aaron's (lease-to-own)
why: Major national lease-to-own retailer; customer account with online payments and autopay.

name: AppleCare (monthly or annual)
why: Very widely held device protection subscription; billed via Apple Account.

name: Acima (lease-to-own)
why: National lease-to-own provider at thousands of retailers (Upbound); own customer portal with ACH/card autopay and online payments. Replaces Allstate Protection Plans, whose public pages publish almost no billing detail (plans mostly prepaid at the retailer).

name: DTE Home Protection Plus (HPP)
why: ~225k customers; well-known Michigan utility-affiliated home repair plan with its own billing.

name: Midland Credit Management (Midland Funding)
why: Largest US debt buyer/servicer (Encore); millions of consumer accounts; own online portal for payment plans, one-time payments and history. Sign-in is account number + SSN last 4 (no password), modelled as an account-number stand-in.

name: Snap Finance
why: National lease-to-own/installment provider (7M+ customers); Customer Portal and apps with Schedule Payment.

name: Katapult (lease-to-own)
why: National lease-to-own platform at major online retailers; app/portal payments, card autopay.

name: Koalafi
why: National lease-to-own provider (formerly West Creek); customer portal/app with one-time and scheduled payments.

name: American First Finance (AFF)
why: Large point-of-sale lease/RISA/bank-loan servicer (~3M customers); My Account with Set Up Auto Pay.

name: Money Management International (MMI)
why: Largest US nonprofit credit counselor; monthly DMP deposits in MyMMI with ACH automated deposits.

name: USPS PO Box rental
why: Very widely held recurring rental; online renewal, automatic renewal and close/refund in PO Boxes Online.

name: SunPower legacy leases/loans/PPAs (SunStrong)
why: ~107k SunPower financed systems; separate SunStrong billing site (sunstrong.youronlineaccount.com) from the Sunnova portal picked in tier 1.

name: Palmetto (LightReach)
why: Fast-growing residential solar lease/PPA provider; Palmetto app billing with autopay discount.

name: TrueAccord
why: Large digital-first collection agency; self-service payment plans, automatic payments and disputes online.
